name: claude-code-slides
description: Create, review, and rehearse portable HTML, Marp, and editable PowerPoint presentations with seven visual themes and nineteen content-aware layouts.

defaultPrompt: Create a technical presentation from this repository using the default claude-editorial template and a varied layout sequence.
Turn this strategy brief into an executive PowerPoint using the executive-brief template.
Review this presentation and fix repetitive layouts and the highest-impact delivery issues.
